title: UI quick wins
description: Ten small UI fixes from the 2026-10-07 review: header buttons no longer clipped, human stage label in the turn banner, no 'You (You)', a single 'Combat complete', a readable map summary, clearer agenda ballot, a styled undo dialog, a 12 px type floor, and an accessible galaxy map.

shots.heading: Header at 1440 px
shots.caption: Status bar, turn banner and the Technologies and Objectives buttons all fit. The banner reads 'Awaiting your choice (Activate system)' instead of the raw engine id activate_system.

shots.heading: Header at 1024 px
shots.caption: The status bar wraps onto a second line; the button group does not shrink, so Objectives is no longer cut at the right edge.

shots.heading: Header at 760 px
shots.caption: On a narrow window the status text wraps further while both buttons keep their full size.

shots.heading: Own card in the player sheet
shots.caption: The viewer's card shows 'You' once; '(You)' is only added when the visible name is something else.

shots.heading: Finished combat
shots.caption: 'Combat complete' appears once (the phase line). The title is just 'Space Combat · System N', the duplicate footer notice is gone, and the round is stated once in the summary.

shots.heading: Map picker summary
shots.caption: The line under the preview reads '6 players · Standard by Community · 37 systems · no hyperlanes'. The Start preset (dev) control is only rendered in dev builds, so it appears here because the capture runs the dev server.

shots.heading: Agenda ballot with two planets staged
shots.caption: One 'Staged: +8 votes' line, a check mark and bold name on staged rows (not only the purple border), '6 votes' instead of '6 v', and one action row: Reset as a link, 'Finish without voting more' secondary, 'Cast votes' primary.

shots.heading: Undo confirmation
shots.caption: Undo from the event log opens the game's own dialog, 'Undo for everyone?', with Keep playing and Undo for everyone. One dialog replaces up to two native confirms.

shots.heading: Reaction dialog text and checkboxes
shots.caption: Helper text is at least 12 px, the faint text colour now has at least 4.5:1 contrast on the dark surfaces, and the Compact card text and Pin checkboxes are 20 px with a 24 px row, with the whole label clickable.

notes.title: Already fine:
notes.text: the dev start-preset select was already gated on import.meta.env.DEV, and the board cursor is accurate because dragging always pans. Item 10 therefore adds the group role, the 'Galaxy map' name and a pan/zoom description.
